learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.
2.

By this application under Section 439 CrPC the petitioner, namely, Hasanur Rahman @ Md.
Hasanur Rahman, is seeking bail in Pragjyotishpur Police Station Case No. 71/2023, registered under Sections 376(D)(A)/34 IPC read with Section 6/17 of POCSO Act, 2012 and read with Section 75 of JJ Act, wherein, he was arrested on 25.05.2023 and since then, he is in custody.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per the FIR of the case, while the minor victim girl in the afternoon on 24.05.2023 at Page No.# 2/2 around 3.30 PM went to fetch water nearby her house, the petitioner and two other boys forcefully committed rape on the grandchild of the informant, the minor victim girl.

4. Perused the Case Diary, the statement of the victim girl recorded under Section 161 CrPC by the concerned I.O. of the case as well as her statement recorded under Section 164 CrPC by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup (Metro), Guwahati on 26.05.2023.
5.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup (Metro), Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The statement of the victim girl made before the police as well as before the learned Magistrate is found to be consistent, wherein, the victim girl pointed out the illegalities against the petitioner.
6. We have also perused the statements of the witnesses recorded so far by the concerned I.O. of the case.

7. Case Diary reveals sufficient incriminating materials against the petitioner regarding his involvement in the alleged crime and as such, the Court is of the opinion that it is not a fit case to grant bail to the petitioner, namely, Hasanur Rahman @ Md. Hasanur Rahman, in said Pragjyotishpur Police Station Case No. 71/2023 at this stage.
8. Accordingly, this bail application of the petitioner, named above, in said Pragjyotishpur Police Station Case No. 71/2023 stands rejected.
